variants.basis: Machine credential scoped to organization, not user session; system-context execution must preserve exact bound tenant and lifecycle permissions.
variants.negative: Rotated/revoked credential, mismatched organization path, disabled provider, unauthorized lifecycle mutation; no other tenant effects.

variants.basis: Verified provider-subject binding and target organization; normal invited identity is distinct from configured enterprise SSO.
variants.negative: Missing or stale provider binding, state replay, wrong organization; no implicit just-in-time provisioning.

variants.actor: Anonymous survey respondent with response capability
variants.basis: Response-specific authority distinct from survey id, tenant member and generic public visitor.
variants.negative: Bare response id, stolen or expired capability, wrong survey/organization; no response write.

variants.actor: Commercial pilot applicant or organization signatory
variants.basis: Applicant ownership and separately attested organization administration/signatory authority.
variants.negative: Unrelated applicant, wrong offer/organization, stale offer, unsupported authority evidence.

variants.basis: Explicit platform pilot authority or admitted applicant/organization context; platform title alone is not a general customer-data entitlement.
variants.negative: Wrong institution/application, revoked platform mandate, self-approval or forbidden scope.

variants.basis: Specific purpose consent and own subject relationship; unrelated to generic membership disclosure.
variants.negative: Revoked, expired or changed purpose consent; unrelated subject and unrestricted export denied.

variants.actor: Authority holder for special-category disclosure grants
variants.basis: Separate equity disclosure grant authority; purpose and recipient-specific scope.
variants.negative: Role-only or foreign-tenant issuer, wrong recipient or purpose; revocation enforced.

variants.actor: Registered mobile device and push transport
variants.basis: Device-to-principal/organization binding, actual provider receipt or truthful failure; not independent session authority.
variants.negative: Other user's device, removed device, invalid provider token, no disclosure of raw token.

variants.actor: Employer data integration or remittance submitter
variants.basis: Exact employer/organization transaction scope plus real financial mandate for restricted action; no positive finance activation in base.
variants.negative: Unbound employer, missing mandate, wrong remittance run, replay and tenant mismatch.

variants.basis: Live pension trustee mandate plus resource/action/state transition; job title is insufficient.
variants.negative: Role-only, expired mandate, foreign benefit, forbidden transition; base financial boundary retained.

variants.basis: Separate institution-designated reviewer authority, redaction and consent conditions; source describes refusal until designated.
variants.negative: No designation, author reviewing own material, missing consent/redaction; no content promoted to shared library.

variants.basis: Distinct authorized officer approval of another officer's draft, scoped organization.
variants.negative: Self-review, wrong organization, stale draft, failed audit; no publication.

variants.actor: Sensitive report-field grant issuer or recipient
variants.basis: Action-specific financial mandate and exact recipient/field scope, independent of report visibility.
variants.negative: Foreign report/field, no mandate, revoked grant; no protected field disclosure.

limits: These are authority contexts, not newly admitted users/roles or new positive base release commitments.
Rule applicability and concrete fixtures remain unverified; the goal is to make specialized and external negative boundaries visible.
